senses.gloss:
उल्बं, --ल्वं
1 The bag which
surrounds the embryo, fœtus.
--2 The
vulva.
--3 The womb.
--4 A cave.

उल्ब(ल्व)ण a.
1 Thick,
clotted, copious, abundant (blood &c.);
˚रुधिरं Mv. 6. 33.
--2 Much,
excessive, intense; Śi. 10. 54, 68,
12. 37; Ku. 7. 84.
--3 Strong,
powerful, great; Śi. 20. 41; ˚रसः
U. 5. 26 the heroic sentiment; Dk. 23,
25; K. 299, 302.
--4 Manifest, clear;
तस्यासीदुल्बणो मार्गः R. 4. 33.
--5 Gaudy,
showy; अनुल्बणवेषेण K. 66.
--णं ind.
Much, heavily (as sighing).
